test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years. If the youngest members are twins and each is 5 years old, what was the average age (in years) of the family members at the time of birth of the twins?
solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of all Observations)/(Total Number of Observations)

**Calculation:**

The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years

⇒ Sum of ages of all family members = 10 × 29 = 290

The youngest members are twins and each is 5 years old

⇒ Sum of ages of the remaining members = 290 – (10 × 5)

⇒ Sum of ages of the remaining members = 290 – 50 = 240

The average age of family members at the time of birth of twins

⇒ 240/8 = 30 years

**∴ The average age of family members at the time of birth of twins is 30 years.**
